searchStringsArray.title: Search Queries
searchStringsArray.description: Business searches to run on Google Maps. Include a location in each query for best results. Google Maps caps a single query at ~120 results - use several narrower queries for wider coverage.

maxResults.title: Max Results per Query
maxResults.description: Maximum number of places to scrape per search query.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google Maps interface language code (hl parameter).

includePlaceDetails.title: Open Place Detail Pages
includePlaceDetails.description: Visit each place's detail page to extract phone, website and opening hours. Disable for a faster, lighter run (feed data only).

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel browser pages. Keep low (1-5) to avoid blocks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended - datacenter IPs are blocked by Google Maps almost instantly.
